v3r_reads.samples: docs/v3q/PROTOCOL.json samples.val (V2 C1 rule; recomputed identically by scripts/v3r/select.py -> docs/v3r/SAMPLES.json)
v3r_reads.prior_twin: docs/v3q/PRIOR_ENSEMBLE_val.json samples[str(index)] {law_posterior_votes, x_log10, nu} (= V3q prior_top2 budget 0)
v3r_reads.refined_twins: data/v3q_refine/val/<index:06d>/{prior_top2,lawmean_best3}/state.json, budget 12 (budgets['12'] or best of the first 12 evals, nested)

v3s_reads: docs/v3p/HANDOFF.json (run configs + best checkpoints + stats) -> docs/v3s/PRIOR_SOURCES.json
fallback: if V3q prior_top2 / lawmean_best3 val searches have not reached 12 evaluations when the rest of v3r is done, v3r runs scripts/v3q/c1_refine.py itself for the missing gripper samples with --out data/v3q_refine (same layout; the script's per-arm run.lock prevents double runs)
